messages:
laura: Heads up — PO#7201 H200 batch from NexaSupply flagged at FRA customs, ETA stalled. 8 units in the shipment, vendor reports 2 DOA on arrival inspection. We need an RMA + mitigation plan: loaners, partial air replacements, or accept refurb. Need quick decision — this affects Dedicated pool capacity for EU customers. :eyes:
ops-bot: Shipment update: AWB 123-45678901 held by customs FRA. Status: 'Release pending HS code + invoice clarification'. ETA unknown.
samir: Can you confirm numbers? how many usable vs DOA vs uninspected?
laura: Totals from vendor: 8 total; 2 DOA (power/board failure), 1 firmware mismatch flagged (holds back validation), 5 potentially releasable after customs.
wei: If 2 are DOA we should request vendor cover DOA replacements + freight. For the firmware mismatch — can we push a remote flash once customs clears?
karim: On the loaner side — we have 4 H200 loaners in EU pool that can be redeployed but that'll reduce spare buffer for infra experiments. Suggest 2 loaners to cover immediate SLAs.
laura: Proposal: ask Nexa to air-ship 2 new units (expedite) + provide 2 temporary loaners (refurb) immediately. We cover customs brokerage fee if vendor takes responsibility for DOA replacements. Also need a preflight inspection step at depot for returned units.
nexSupply-rep: We can do 2 expedite air replacements within 5 business days. We will cover DOA replacement units but request 60% cost-share on expedited freight (vendor covers 40%). Customs hold is due to missing commercial invoice line items — we submitted updated docs at 09:12 CET.
samir: 60/40 freight split seems high on our side. Can we instead take freight and deduct from future invoice? Or accept vendor covers freight for DOA only and we cover customs brokerage?
nexSupply-rep: We can accept a credit note on next invoice for 50% of freight if Redwood covers brokerage. Otherwise vendor must take 40% freight per T&Cs.
wei: Operational ask — we need RMA IDs and return labels now. Also serial reconciliation sheet with the unit IDs earmarked for loaners vs returns.
laura: Action list: 1) Nexa to issue RMA IDs for the 2 DOA + 1 firmware mismatch (3 RMAs). 2) Nexa to book 2 expedited air spares (AWB TBD). 3) Redwood ops to prepare 2 temporary loaners and update canary/dedicated routing. 4) Depot to perform preflight inspection and log firmware.
karim: I'll tag the loaners: `nodepool:eu-loaner-02` & `nodepool:eu-loaner-03` and push a flag to provisioning: `infractl node tag --set reserve=vendor-loaner --nodes eu-loaner-02,eu-loaner-03`.
laura: Nexa — please confirm AWB for the 2 expedites and provide tracking. Also need return label format for FRA depot (contact: FRA-DEPOT ops).
nexSupply-rep: Understood. I will issue RMA-9876, RMA-9877, RMA-9878 by EOD CET and upload return labels (FRA depot PDF). Expedites booked — tentative AWB 789-00011122 (air) for the 2 new units.
samir: Please add HS code classification to the commercial invoice: HS 8473.30 (compute accelerators) and include serial ranges. That should speed customs.
laura: Also: firmware mismatch unit — do not attempt field flash before depot preflight. If depot can flash and validate, great; otherwise it's RMA too.
wei: Confirming we will not accept refurbished swaps without burn-in verification. Depot test checklist: power-on, mem test, firmware version, rails check, brief 5m load test.
karim: I'll schedule depot slot for inspection: Mon 09:00 CET slot tentative. If shipping arrives later we push to Tue.
laura: Cost note: if vendor credits 50% freight on next invoice, finance wants a short memo and PO amendment. @samir can you draft?
samir: Yep, will draft a short amendment template and ping Nexa for signature.
ops-bot: Infra alert: Dedicated EU capacity forecast impacted by -8 GPUs for 3-10 days. Recommend notifying key customers via account team.
laura: Agreed — @karim loop in account eng for customers with tight latency SLOs.
karim: Will do. Also logging infra command to fetch allocation state: `infractl allocations get --po 7201 --region eu-west-1` — run once we have AWB cleared.
laura: Thanks all. Nexa: please confirm RMA numbers and AWB once live. We'll finalize loaner deployment after we have labels. :thumbsup:
